qr_style.title: QR code style
qr_style.description: The default look of every link's QR code. Editors and viewers download codes in this style.
qr_style.preview_hint: Example link. Test-scan a printed proof before a print run.
qr_style.not_configured: Not saved yet: QR codes use the standard look until you save a style.
qr_style.save_failed: Could not save the QR style

fields.error_correction_hint: Higher levels survive damage and a centre logo better, but make denser codes. Auto uses H with a centre image, otherwise Q.
fields.logo_hint: PNG or SVG, up to 200 KB. Square images with some padding work best.
fields.logo_invalid: Upload a PNG or SVG image smaller than 200 KB
fields.link_icon: Without a logo, show the destination site's icon
fields.scan_marker: Mark scans in the click log
fields.scan_marker_hint: Adds a parameter to the encoded short link so scans are counted as QR scans. It is passed on to the destination.
